description_en: This Gaṇeśa temple is located at an open square behind the Cyāsal Hiṭī (LAL1600). The temple has a square sanctum and can be accessed from the south. The main structural elements of the temple are its thick wall and four sturdy timber posts, all of which support the two-tier roof above them. Leaning against the rear wall, a weathered image of the main deity is framed by a double sequence of vertical jambs and tympana. The main entry door is clad in carved metal sheets and flanked by guardian animals. A Nandī sits in line with the central axis of the main entrance, approximately 8 m to its south.Inside the sanctum, one can find an image of a three-headed Gaṇeśa with a large crown. A brasstoraṇaabove this statue contains images of Nṛtyeśvara in the middle and Gaṇeśa on his right and Kumāra on his left; a similartoraṇahangs above the entrance of the sanctum. The front facade of the temple and the door are both clad in brass plates. Metal flags have been erected on either side of the door and two brass-clad lion statues guard the temple. A bell hangs on the right side of the temple's plinth. Various figures have been painted on the four walls of the first floor. The gilded pinnacle is topped with a parasol that is flanked by two metal flags. Three metal banners hang down from this pinnacle.Aguṭhīconducted by Vyañjanakāras organises the annual Pūjā and other religious functions of the temple.
description_ne: च्यासलबाट गःछेँ टोलतिर जाने बाटो छेउमा यो मन्दिर अवस्थित छ । च्यासलका टोलवासीहरूले स्थानगणेशको रूपमा पूज्ने गणेशको प्रतिमामाथि ठूलो किरीट देखिन्छ तर हात र आयुधहरू स्पष्ट छैनन् । मूर्तिको माथि र गर्भगृहको ढोकामाथि पनि उस्तै प्रकृतिका अर्थात् बीचमा नृत्येश्वर, दायाँ गणेश र बाँया कुमारको मूर्ति रहेको पित्तलका तोरणहरू रहेका छन् । मन्दिरको भूमि तल्लाको मोहोडा भागलाई पित्तलको पाताले मोडी सजाइएको छ भने ढोका अगाडि पनि पित्तलकै पाताले मोडिएका सिंहका दुई मूर्तिहरू स्थापित छन् । ढोकाको दायाँ–बायाँ पित्तलका ध्वजाहरू खडा छन् भने ढोका आगाडि एउटा घण्टा झुण्ड्याइएको छ । मन्दिरको पहिलो तलामा चारैतर्फ भित्तेचित्र कोरिएका छन् । सुनको मोरम्बा लगाइएको गजुरमाथि छत्र पनि ओढाइएको छ । गजुरबाट लत्रिएका तीनवटा पताःहरू पहिलो छानाको तलसम्म आइपुगेको छ ।यस मन्दिरसँग सम्बन्धित एउटा गुठी छ, जसको सञ्चालन व्यञ्जनकारहरूले गर्दछन् । त्यस गुठीले वैशाख पूर्णिमाका दिन यस मन्दिरको वर्षवर्धन पूजा तथा अन्य धार्मिक सांस्कृतिक कार्यहरूको आयोजना गर्ने गर्दछ ।

historical_events.event_name: Donation of brass fringe of the roof (jhalara)
historical_events.event_description: Thula Saṅkrāntiguṭhī, Kisamā̃, Siramã etc. donated the brass fringe of the roof (jhalara).
Rāmalāla Vyañjanakāra and Tuyumaiyā Vyañjanakāra donated two lion statues clad in brass. These are placed in front of the main entrance.
The inscription is partially broken, and so it is not clear what event this commemorates exactly. The inscription mentions that something was established and land was bestowed upon theguṭhī.

historical_events.event_name: Covering the upper roof with brass plate
historical_events.event_description: Harṣamāna Vyañjanakāra and his other family members covered the upper roof of the temple with copper plate. The metal banners partially cover the place where the date is written, and so it could not be identified.

historical_events.event_name: Fixing of the golden pinnacle and the flags
historical_events.event_description: A golden pinnacle and two flags were fixed on top of the temple by Caturdaśīguṭhī.
The terracotta pinnacle of the temple was removed and a gilded pinnacle was installed by Jujumāna Vyañjanakāra.

historical_events.event_name: Covering the lower roof of the temple with brass plates
historical_events.event_description: Rāju Rājeśa and Lakṣmī covered the roofs of the temple with brass plates.
The temple was renovated, andkṣamāpūjāwas performed by Kulavīra Vyañjanakāra and Siṃtālī.
Āsāmadu Tepe donated a bell. This is fixed in front of the temple.
Mājuvīra and his family members donated a metal banner (patāḥ) to Gaṇeśa.
